text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Hah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I've thought about it some more since then,
but… 
how exactly do I put in more effort?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(So far,
I've been doing everything to change myself…
or that was the plan at least.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …But I haven't changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright! 
Let's go run another one then!

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Me too! 
Wait up big sis～!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…I could never… 
be like them… and yet…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(And yet… trainer praised me.
Talked about all of my strong points.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Can I do anything? Anything at all…

Something that I can do… 
I wonder, is there anything like that?
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should ask the trainer directly,
just like what that girl from earlier
did.)

…And yet,
I don't have anything to complain about…
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I should try thinking up a menu for
my trainer? 
It doesn't have to be training related,
maybe if I…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I thought up a meal plan for you. 
Of course I would be the one making it,
so you don't need to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"You even went so far to make it something
nutritious and delicious… Thank you!
I'd love for you to keep making this,
if it's fine with you!?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't mind at all. 
Just leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…… 
…No… let's… not go with that…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haah… I just thought of something weird,
didn't I.
I need to change how I approach this—

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Cheval! What a coinkydink!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah… hello. A c-coinkydink?

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
…Fufu, hey, the thing is. 
I just came back from a cafe and you know～

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

—It's been quite some time since I had a
day off,
so I've been spending it leisurely at a
cafe.

Atop my table was a training textbook,
as well as records of Cheval Grand's
growth.
choice_data_list: This is a nice change of pace…

text_block_list.text:
This change in scenery is enough to lift my
mood. Feeling refreshed,
I was about to write down a new training
menu for Cheval, when—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-trainer… hello…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Um, I just heard that… you were here. 
So… um…

She had something she wanted to say,
but she was fidgeting and was averting her
gaze.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Huh? That book… Are you, even on your day off,
studying training methods?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That said, is it… a new training menu,
for me?

Now that she said it,
this is still work isn't it. 
I was enjoying it so much,
I almost forgot that.
choice_data_list: I need to tailor this menu just fo...
I need to tailor this menu just fo...

text_block_list.text:
Since Cheval's been growing stronger,
I have to keep changing the menu to keep up
with her growth.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
…Fufu, hey, the thing is. 
I just came back from a cafe and you know～

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
and there I saw your trainer just chatting
it up with both Verxina and Vivlos～

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps they're trying to scout him?
Perhaps they both got their eyes on your
trainer～?

text_block_list.name: Joke Loving Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Just～ Kidding! Ahaha,
it was a joke!
They just passed by and said hi to him,
and then… huh, 
Cheval? Wai-, Cheval～!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I wonder… what they're talking about…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(No, something like that is irrelevant. 
But… if they were to get near them,
with how sparkling and dazzling they are…)

(If that happened… I wouldn't… even be able
to compare to them…)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…Trainer is… different from me.
They're in a different world.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(And yet,
they're spending their day off doing this,
because of me…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…T-trainer. 
You should be resting… on your day off.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Aren't you… tired?
choice_data_list: Nope, I'm having fun right now…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

At first I thought I'd keep my personal and
work life balanced,
but I just can't stop thinking about
training.
choice_data_list: I got it! If you're okay with it—

text_block_list.text:
I also wanted to ask her for her opinion.
So I prompted her to take a seat if she had
the time to spare.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah… Um… O-okay…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(…They're going through all of this because
of me, and yet…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (They're still having fun?)
choice_data_list: Okay, so if we go with this—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (My chest feels… tingly…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (…What's… going on with me?)
